# Claim-responder edits start all fourteen Engine browser shards

## Context

While clearing Engine pull requests for v14, a repair to the contributor claim workflow started fourteen Engine browser jobs. The [classifier log](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/43908105577/job/133442331687) lists four changed files, `run_e2e=true` and `e2e_selection=full`. The diff contains the workflow, its helper, its unit spec and CONTRIBUTING.md. The browser jobs compete with actual grid and Portal changes.

## The Problem

Of those four paths, only `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` admits the browser tier. It supplies contributor claim/standing workflows. The e2e job neither imports it through its build or browser dependencies nor executes it. Its unit tests and the security scanner do exercise the relevant surfaces. Claim policy is a recurring edit, as the [file history](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/commits/dev/buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs) shows.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: the file-boundary contract in #20329. `.github/workflows/classify-test-scope.yml` defaults new build scripts into the browser tier. Only proven browser-unreachable files leave it, with tests that turn red when the dependency assumption changes. The stable `e2e-engine` check still reports on a deliberate skip.

## The Fix

Use the existing e2e launch-chain exception for the exact helper, retain the broad default for `buildScripts/util/`, and cover the real four-file change and a mixed change through the actual workflow step. Add a tripwire for a new browser or build dependency on the helper, including a path through `contributorStanding.mjs`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The four-file claim PR selects units and skips the Engine browser tier. Its report identifies the helper as outside the launch chain.
- [ ] Adding a runtime, e2e or unclassified utility path still runs the browser suite. Its required aggregate status, unit, build and security checks retain their existing behavior.
- [ ] A new browser or launch-chain dependency on either the claim helper or its standing consumer fails the reachability control.

## Out of Scope

Claim semantics, security exceptions, cancellation of running jobs, changes to branch protection and a directory-wide util exemption.

| #21015 · `d4ea2c76e0` | The last guard entry was `spec retirement` at 18:02:30 UTC. No further guard output preceded cancellation; cleanup terminated two Git processes and `git-remote-https` at 18:17:51, 15m21s later. The other two baseline jobs had already passed. [Original job](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/43924339433/job/133500169292) | [Passed in 88s](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/43924339433/job/133510330204). All seven required checks passed. |

The workflow puts `git fetch --unshallow` and the Node guard under one log heading. The surviving HTTPS process is evidence of an outstanding Git operation. There is no JavaScript assertion failure in either record. Timing those two commands separately would make the next slow run diagnosable. [Workflow at the tested revision](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/d4ea2c76e0006d82875808aa04028e44e2bb63a0/.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml#L78)

I ran the actual guard against a small Git history. The PR side deleted a unit spec without a retirement account, then made an unrelated tip commit. With full history it enumerated both commits and exited 1, naming the missing spec. Marking only the common base shallow produced the same two commits and the same refusal. Marking the PR tip and base shallow enumerated only one commit and **incorrectly exited 0**.

The guard needs the complete `origin/dev..HEAD` range: commits reachable from the checked-out PR revision after excluding the base’s reachable commits, with the parent trees needed for each diff, including merge resolutions and rename detection. History older than a proven common boundary is dispensable. A bounded fetch would need to prove that no PR-side boundary hides a contributing commit or parent and fall back to more history if it cannot. [Range and per-commit Git reads](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/d4ea2c76e0006d82875808aa04028e44e2bb63a0/buildScripts/util/check-spec-retirement.mjs#L423)
